## The program for the next generation of supply chain engineers.

Crescendo is Lyric's cohort-based program for supply chain analysts, modelers, and builders with a goal of expanding your capabilities and helping you become a more well rounded Supply Chain Engineer.

Weeks · 1 day onsite

## 5

A focused journey that transforms how you solve supply chain challenges and one day onsite.

Engineers

## 30

A hand-picked cohort learning, building, and growing together.

Virtual Live Sessions

## 16

Interactive workshops, expert insights, and collaborative co-builds.

Hours / Week

## 10

A balanced commitment of live learning and hands-on project work.

## You're becoming an Upper-Right Engineer.

Supply chain decisions are technical and political. The best engineers don't win by math alone, and they don't win on charisma either. They live at the intersection, and that's where Crescendo is taking you.

## Rigorous and creative.

Anyone can run the model. The best engineers also notice what the data is quietly trying to tell them.

## Quantitative and persuasive.

Numbers that move rooms, not just spreadsheets. The math is necessary; the framing is what closes.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a455ce597623f0a8ccc7577/6a7489e0f5d96c704378349e_Chart.avif)

## Builder and narrator.

You ship the prototype and you tell the story that makes the room act on it.

AI2

The Crescendo operating system

## Algorithmic Intelligence x Agentic Intelligence

Algorithmic Intelligence is the optimization, ML, and forecasting that powers Lyric Studio. It's the math that makes the decision. Agentic Intelligence is the suite of AI co-pilots inside Lyric Studio that change how you do the work (synthetic data, modeling, app design), plus the chance to build your own agents for the boutique problems your team owns. Every week you get more fluent at both.

## Who you become, week by week.

Each week is a skill, not a deliverable. The builds are the path. The transformation is the point.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a455ce597623f0a8ccc7577/6a74a730954206a94e9a66ce_progress_week_1.avif)

Decode any supply chain problem

Craft synthetic data. The data itself isn't the point. It's the forcing function. Generate it from scratch and you're forced to understand every input, every constraint, every assumption beneath the surface. Master the structure, and the model writes itself.

Build

Synthetic dataset + Blue Note run + one-page write-up

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a455ce597623f0a8ccc7577/6a74a7300fda6eed1863df13_progress_week_2.avif)

Compose like an engineer

One algorithm rarely answers the real question. Chain Lyric notes into sequences (optimization, ML, forecasting) that hold together. Defend your composition: which notes, in what order, for which problem.

Build

A composed sequence with at least two notes wired together

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a455ce597623f0a8ccc7577/6a74a7304a7be804194b309b_progress_week_3.avif)

Ship a product, not a dashboard

Apps aren't dashboards. Design for one named persona (Strategic Stan, Tactical Tina, or Execution Eric) against our undeniable product principles. By Friday your teammates run your analysis without ever seeing the math.

Build

A persona-driven Lyric Studio app · Industry guest

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a455ce597623f0a8ccc7577/6a74a730812506892a59b2c6_progress_week_4.avif)

Present like a TED speaker

The work is brilliant, but the room has to feel it. Pick one of the Seven Stories, shape your arc on the Hero's Journey, record a two-minute trailer that earns you the Chicago stage.

Build

Two-minute trailer video · Industry guests

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a455ce597623f0a8ccc7577/6a74a7302a3c3f8bf05937e7_progress_week_5.avif)

Earn your trophy in Chicago

One day in person. You take the stage. Ten minutes, your work, your story, in front of the cohort and a room of guests. One graduate wins Best Storyteller. Cohort dinner that night.

Build

A live ten-minute presentation on Thu, Oct 22 in Chicago

## Frequently asked questions

How much time per week should I plan for?

About 10 hours per week for the first four weeks. Four virtual live sessions a week (Mon teaching, Tue mini, Wed co-build, Thu mini), each running 60 to 90 minutes, plus async build, peer review, and final polish in between. Week 5 is the in-person Finale in Chicago.

Do I need to be a current Lyric customer?

Yes. Crescendo is currently open only to practitioners at Lyric customer accounts. The curriculum runs on Lyric Studio, so you'll need an active account. Not yet a Lyric customer? Reach out to our team.

What's included in the program?

Five weeks of live sessions, optional mini-sessions, Lyric Studio access, peer-cohort tooling, the Chicago Finale day (sessions, lunch, dinner), your certificate, and continued post-cohort gym access. Not included: flights and hotel for Chicago.

I went through the pilot. How does pricing work for me?

Pilot graduates and returning moderators get a private promo code from the Lyric team. Reach out to your CSBP or to Frank and Erin directly. Apply the code at registration to unlock the appropriate discount.

What does the Chicago day look like?

One full day in Chicago on Thursday, Oct 22, 2026. Morning and afternoon pitch rounds, with every student presenting their ten-minute narrative in front of the cohort, the Lyric team, and a room of guests. Best Storyteller is named at the end of the day. Cohort dinner downtown that night.

## Thirty seats. One cohort. Sept 21.

Five weeks. Real prototypes. A live day in Chicago. A peer network you'll keep.
